messages:
alice: Heads-up — running into a parity bug in the Python sampleapp: async embeddings + rerank path. On 401 the async retry drops Authorization so gateway logs show missing header.
ben: That sounds like the async retry middleware isn't reconstructing the auth header before re-sending. Can you paste the smallest repro?
alice: Minimal repro in the issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/issues/4567 — uses AsyncEmbeddingsClient and a local mock that returns 401 once, then 200.
alice: Repro snippet:
```
from redwood import AsyncEmbeddingsClient
client = AsyncEmbeddingsClient(api_key=os.environ['RW_KEY'])
await client.embed_many(["a","b"])  # triggers token refresh in CI
```
carol: SDK version?
alice: 0.12.3rc
drew: I suspect a request object is being reused in the async retry loop; some async http libs (httpx) require new Request or ensure headers are recomputed.
ben: I'll try to reproduce with httpx.MockTransport. If it's request reuse we'll fix by generating new request in the retry handler and reattaching fresh headers.
ben: Opening PR now to reattach Authorization on async retries and add a unit test for MockTransport.
ben: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/pull/1234
deploy-bot: CI passed: pytest 134 passed (ubuntu-latest)
carol: Also a typing issue: embed_many currently returns Any which means downstream rerank helpers accept opaque values. We should annotate embed_many -> List[List[float]] and update reranker typing to accept Sequence[Sequence[float]].
drew: I'll add a batching helper test that asserts we don't double-JSON-encode the body and that Content-Type is application/json for rerank POSTs.
ben: Adding typing stubs and a changelog note. Also adding a small sampleapp e2e (async path) to CI matrix to catch regressions.
devex: @devex I'll update onboarding docs and add an "async auth retry" troubleshooting note in sample-apps/README.
alice: Thanks team. Can we cut an rc patch once PR merges so pilot onboarding isn't blocked?
carol: Scheduling a patch release after changelog + RC smoke.
alice: :thumbsup:
